Keeps the largest value of each pooling window.

Reduces height and width by the stride (PyTorch MaxPool2d rules); the channel count stays. Runs on ArrayFire.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Pooling](../categories/pooling.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Search words | maxpool, pooling |

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Input** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Image feature map [H, W, C] per sample. |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |

| **Output** | Tensor | Yes | 1 | Pooled feature map [H', W', C]. |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pooling | Pool Size | `pool_size` | Integer | `2` | `1-1048576` | The run | Square pooling-window size. Required. |
| Pooling | Stride | `stride` | Integer | `2` | `1-1048576` | The run | Spatial pooling stride. Required. |
| Pooling | Padding | `padding` | Integer | `0` | `0-524288` | The run | Cells added on every side before pooling, at most half the pool size (torch padding). ResNet's first pool is size 3, stride 2, padding 1. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).

## Usage

```text
Commonly used with 2x2 kernel and stride 2 to halve dimensions.
```

## Tips

- Preserves strong activations, good for detecting features.
- Consider stride in Conv2D as alternative in modern architectures.
